in_sanskrit.name: Oshansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Oshansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ashan’ meaning ‘throne’ and ‘Sha’ meaning ‘Lord of’. Oshansh is the name of the deity who is believed to be the Lord of Wealth, prosperity, and abundance.

in_hindi.name: Oshansh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth

in_tamil.name: Oshansh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of Wealth

Oshansh is the name of the deity who is believed to be the Lord of Wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
